Initial release of yotta-school-doc.

- Provides local, deterministic drafting and validation of school official documents based on versioned rulesets and structured facts.
- Generates reproducible document skeletons and missing-item checklists without inventing facts.
- Validates completeness, date formats/order, attachments, placeholders, sensitive terms, overclaims, personal student info, and meeting action items.
- Operates fully offline, with zero network/model dependencies; no confidential data leaves the machine.
- Helps integrate document checks into automated flows (supports CI gating via `--gate findings=n`).
- Focused on skeletons and deterministic gaps—does not generate full drafts, real names, numbers, or policy conclusions.
